RFC 8785 (JSON Canonicalization Scheme) conformance vectors.
Copied verbatim from the reference suite:
  https://github.com/cyberphone/json-canonicalization  (testdata/input, testdata/output)
Used by test/chain-jcs.test.ts to prove src/chain.ts canonical() emits
byte-identical JCS output, so a TrueFact chain is third-party verifiable.
